title: Run model: journal records to decision steps, from the run's own graph (pure)
tests:
Against F0:
- (a) arrived; path right; each pick equals the click ref mapped through the snapshot
- (b) a park with reason 'top x under floor 0.35'; the answer gives pick.how = answer
- (c) unresumable, naming the errored jev_choose step
- (d) cancelled
- (e) failed, even though the door said completed
- (f) rule and single picks
- (g) an entail error, then an unresumable park
- (h) an invalid answer re-parks and uses an escalation
- the graph is rebuilt from the journal pages (its sha matches the PIN in the fixture)
- the cut collision flag
- feeding records one at a time equals feeding them all at once
live_check: Pure module; W2b-1 and W2b-2 carry the live check.
risk: jev_graph page framing is read from journaled text. If the plugin's page format changes, the fallback label appears instead of a wrong drawing.
